title: The Besse volume of a contact form is bounded by the volume of the normalised form on the boundary
author: Alberto Abbondandolo; Christian Lange; Marco Mazzucchelli
work: Higher systolic inequalities for 3-dimensional contact manifolds
source_version: Journal de l'École polytechnique — Mathématiques 9 (2022), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.195
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled lemma `l:volume_Besse` at source lines 1227-1233: the Besse volume of the contact form is bounded above by the volume of the normalised form measured on the boundary. The author's proof (source lines 1235-1269) runs the computation through the branched covering model of the solid cylinder: the volume form induced by lambda wedge dlambda is transferred to the collar coordinates in which the normalised form is dt + pr_1^* nu_0 (source line 1214-1219 and the covering equation retained as context), and the inequality is then obtained by controlling the multiplicities of the covering and reducing to the boundary volume of nu_0. The statement is a single inequality between two volumes and records neither the transfer to the collar nor the use of the fold number.

contexts.label: the author's branched covering equation describing the restriction of tilde-iota, which the retained proof uses to compare the two volume forms
